note: San Diego County park on Morena Reservoir near Campo, on open chaparral and oak ground a short walk from the Pacific Crest Trail; also wilderness cabins. Boat rentals and fishing on the reservoir; no swimming or body contact with the water. --Claude
summary: Lake Morena County Park: $39 partial / $42 full hookup (Jan 2026 county schedule), reservable on the county engine (14-night max), 86 sites (56 hookup sites 36-70 ft, 50 A, water; 38 full hookup), showers + dump, year-round. Lakeview kept with a caveat (reservoir drawn down; no water in site photos). Pin moves ~810 m from the cabin area to the RV loops. Note rewritten (the '~80+ sites, some with hookups' line). Website and phone added.
flags: PIN MOVE (~810 m): stored 32.6872,-116.5260 sits on the cabin area (C-1..C-10) at the west end; the RV/tent loops' centroid from the county engine is 32.68448,-116.51798 (sites 1-86). Suggest -> 32.68448,-116.51798.

WATERFRONT: lakeview kept (not --AWH), weakly. Morena Reservoir is deeply drawn down (CDEC storage 6,163 AF in Oct 2026, roughly an eighth of capacity); today's water edge is ~440 m NW of the nearest row (sites 1-15, e.g. site 9 at ~32.68484,-116.5195) across the open, treeless drawdown flat (DEM 913-921 m vs the camp's 929 m), so at high water the lake fills the flat in front of that row. But none of the engine photos for sites 4, 9, 12, 15, 80 or 85 shows water - they look north over the dry flat - and no named site is within ~50 m of any high-water line I could fix. Not lakefront. A reviewer who wants a sightline in today's photos would take it to not waterfront.
SITE LENGTH: all 56 hookup sites take 23 ft+; the 9 non-hookup and 19 tent sites are 15 ft (not RV).

UNREAD: sewer at the 38 'Full Hookup' sites is inferred from the type name (the engine's checklist shows only Electric and Water); rates are from the county schedule, not an engine quote (the engine's site list carries no price; not added to a cart).
